view.summary: Sort plates on a conveyor rail: serve the desserts, discard the bomb plates and hit both buttons for double plates. Correct streaks build a Combo and Fever for big scores.

overview.title: A run
items: 60 s (a warning shows in the last 10 s)
Left button (A / ←) serves a dessert, right button (D / →) discards a bomb, both at once sort a double plate
A wrong sort resets the Combo and locks the rail for 1 s
Every 20 plates a special plate comes along; sorting it correctly turns the next 7 plates into the same type as the one at the front

overview.title: Scoring
items: 100, plus a Combo bonus (+100 / +200 / +300 / +400 at the ×2 to ×5 Combo tiers)
+500 per correct sort, full at 10,000 (20 correct sorts); Fever Time starts when it is full
Each correct sort adds more than one to the Combo: Lv 1: ×2, Lv 2: ×3, Lv 3: ×4, Lv 4: ×5. A mistake lowers the Fever level.
500 gauge points at a time; a count of 15 is needed before the next Fever (meaning unclear)
